description: The file defines the Request class within the OrangeHRM system, specifically in the API v2 namespace for the Core plugin. It manages HTTP request data, encapsulating parameters from different parts of an HTTP request such as body, URL attributes, and query string. It provides methods to access and modify these parameters, facilitating handling HTTP requests in the application.

classes.name: Request
classes.description: Represents an HTTP request within the OrangeHRM API v2, encapsulating request data such as body parameters, URL attributes, and query string parameters. Provides methods to access and modify these data components for API request handling.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Request object with an HttpRequest, extracting all request, attribute, and query parameters into ParameterBag instances.

methods.name: getBody
methods.description: Returns the ParameterBag holding request body parameters ($_POST).

methods.name: setBody
methods.description: Sets the ParameterBag for request body parameters.

methods.name: getAttributes
methods.description: Returns the ParameterBag with URL attributes.

methods.name: setAttributes
methods.description: Sets the ParameterBag for URL attributes.

methods.name: getQuery
methods.description: Returns the ParameterBag with query string parameters ($_GET).

methods.name: setQuery
methods.description: Sets the ParameterBag for query string parameters.

methods.name: getAllParameters
methods.description: Merges and returns all request parameters: body, attributes, and query.
